title: Ensure previous approvals are dismissed when new changes are pushed
description: Without this, an author can collect approvals on a harmless diff and then push anything they like to the same branch before merging. The approval no longer refers to the code that ships.
remediation: "Unapprove automatically on new changes" is provided by Auto Unapprove, a free Atlassian app installed separately on recent Bitbucket Data Center versions (Administration -> Find new apps -> "Auto Unapprove for Bitbucket Data Center"). Once installed, enable it at Repository settings -> Pull requests, at Project settings -> Pull requests to apply it to every repository in the project, or at the instance level; repositories and projects inherit it from the level above unless they override it.
fixSummary: Install the Auto Unapprove app, then enable it at Repository settings -> Pull requests.
